text:
anna: Quick heads-up from a UX sweep on /insights: keyboard focus disappears on the table rows after upgrading table virtualization. Also legend swatches have no accessible names.

michael: I can repro. On Windows + Chrome 118, tab to row -> focus shows for a sec then vanishes when virtualization recycles nodes. Seems like focus is being moved to an offscreen node.

rui: Found two code issues: 1) virtualization unmounts focused row on scroll, 2) legend swatches are pure <span class=\"swatch\" aria-hidden> with no aria-describedby. Quick fixes: ensure virtualization preserves DOM node while focused (or move focus to a stable parent), and add aria-labels to swatches.

a11y-bot: Auto report: axe-core (2026-12-22) reports \"Focusable elements are not visible\" and \"Color-contrast insufficient\" on /insights/table.

michael: For focus ring I'd rather we move the ring to a stable container (.row-shell) that isn't recycled. CSS: `.row-shell:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(2,112,255,0.9); outline: none; }` Keeps ring even when content swaps.

rui: Agree. Also need to avoid tabindex=\"-1\" on interactive elements accidentally. I saw a hidden analytics link that had tabindex default. Will change to pointer-only and aria-hidden.

anna: Small copy/accessibility note: chart descriptions currently read \"Model throughput\" only; add context like \"Model throughput over time, lines show p95 and median\" in aria-description so screen readers get useful context.

michael: I'll open a tiny PR: keep focused row DOM stable, add box-shadow focus ring, add aria-labels to legend swatches, and change non-critical toasts to aria-live=\"polite\". Will attach quick Playwright e2e that tabs through table and asserts focus does not vanish.

a11y-bot: Recommendation: add CI smoke test that runs keyboard nav on /insights with reduced flakiness tolerance.

rui: Filed INF-4310 with repro steps + VoiceOver/Narrator notes and screenshots.

anna: Thanks team 49a please add browser/version matrix in the ticket.
